description:
Follows T-042. With auto-accept, a bad LLM passage would serve every visitor and could not be removed. Michael asked on 2026-10-08 for a retire command and a grounding check before enabling adventure in production.

Grounding check (adventure/narrator.py grounding_problems): lexical; flags mid-sentence names absent from the packet, interpretive vocabulary the record doesn't use, numbers not in the packet, a single-word name used as a common noun unless the record does so, and drift below 70% stem overlap. Runs on every LLM passage before it joins the world. A refused passage is stored retired with its reasons; the visitor gets the local verbatim record plus a line explaining why. ADVENTURE_LLM_ATTEMPTS_PER_SLOT (default 2) caps LLM attempts per slot per record version; refused attempts count against the world budget.

Retire: WorldPassage gains retired_at and retired_reason (migration 0003); uniqueness applies to live rows only, so a retired slot can be rewritten. manage.py retire_passage <world> lists (--list/--grep/--retired), retires by key or --id, or sweeps live LLM passages through the check (--check). Dry run unless --apply.

Calibration on real data: four faithful live Wolf Hall passages pass; the earlier Esher leak is refused on five counts; the Wolsey "testament" wording passes because it is the record's own; a Dracula-style invented leather cover is refused; 701 of 731 local Wolf Hall passages pass (the rest are the engine's stock empty-record line, and local passages are never checked); five new live Happy Valley passages were all accepted and read as faithful. Limits: it checks vocabulary, not meaning, so invented detail in the record's own words and misattribution get through; those need retire_passage or a later model-based check.

Verification: 119 adventure+chat tests pass. Command exercised on Wolf Hall's real rows in dev, including the real CLI path; a method named check() had shadowed Django's system checks and was renamed. Migrations 0002-0003 applied to dev only. Five live OpenRouter calls in this round.
title: Grounding check before auto-accept, and a command to retire shared passages
